While the expert uses 'compressed expertise' (SRC_003) to jump to a conclusion, the panel's reliability is derived from the additive probability of multiple agents detecting a single checklist violation, effectively transforming a high-variance individual process into a low-variance group process.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
